# Vocabulary: failure_model

What happens when the system goes wrong.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | None | No fail state; mistakes only reduce efficiency. |
| `soft-recoverable` | Soft / recoverable | Setbacks cost resources or time but play continues. |
| `hard-restart` | Hard restart | Defined fail state ends the scenario or run. |
| `permadeath` | Permadeath | Individual agents or the avatar die permanently; the world persists. |
| `cascading-collapse` | Cascading collapse | Failures propagate through coupled systems until the whole settlement or system collapses. |
